document_overview.product: Website development, maintenance, hosting, and technical support services

executive_summary: This Service Agreement, effective September 1, 2026, sets out the relationship between BrightWeb Solutions Ltd. (the Service Provider) and Ahmed Khan (the Client) for website development, maintenance, hosting, and technical support. The Client will pay a one-time setup fee of USD 500 and a monthly service fee of USD 150, with payments due on the 5th of each month, and late fees may apply if payments are overdue. The initial term is twelve months and will automatically renew for additional twelve‑month periods unless either party gives written cancellation notice at least sixty days before the term ends; renewal fees may change with thirty‑day notice. The agreement includes provisions for early termination, liability limits, confidentiality, dispute resolution through arbitration in London, and governing law of England and Wales.

attention_areas.what_document_says: After the initial term, the agreement renews automatically for another 12‑month period unless written cancellation is given 60 days before expiration; renewal fees are based on the provider’s then‑current pricing and the provider may change pricing with 30 days written notice.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: The client could be bound to future fees that may be higher than the original rate without actively reviewing the changes.

attention_areas.what_document_says: If the client ends the agreement early, they must pay a fee equal to 50% of all remaining monthly service fees for the unused portion of the contract.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: This creates a substantial cost if the client needs to end the relationship before the 12‑month term.

attention_areas.what_document_says: The service provider limits its liability to the total amount of fees paid by the client during the previous three months and disclaims indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or lost‑profit damages.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: The client’s ability to recover damages is capped, which may affect risk exposure.

attention_areas.what_document_says: Disputes that cannot be resolved through good‑faith negotiation within 30 days must be settled by binding arbitration in London, United Kingdom.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: Arbitration limits the client’s ability to pursue court action and may affect how disputes are resolved.

attention_areas.what_document_says: The service provider may modify service features, pricing, or policies by providing written notice; continued use of the services after the effective date of the changes constitutes acceptance.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: The client could be bound by new terms without explicit agreement, impacting costs or service scope.

attention_areas.topic: Late payment fee and service suspension
attention_areas.what_document_says: Payments unpaid for more than five days incur a late fee of 5% of the outstanding amount; if unpaid for more than thirty days, the provider may suspend all services while the client remains responsible for all fees.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: Additional fees and possible interruption of services increase the cost of delayed payments.

attention_areas.what_document_says: The client must provide accurate information, images, documents, passwords, and ensure supplied materials do not infringe third‑party intellectual property rights.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: Failure to meet these obligations could lead to breach of contract or additional liabilities.

attention_areas.what_document_says: Both parties must keep each other’s confidential information private and not disclose it to third parties, with the duty lasting three years after termination.
attention_areas.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for handling sensitive information during and after the relationship.

potential_benefits.title: Clear payment schedule
potential_benefits.explanation: Monthly service fees of USD 150 are due on the 5th day of each month, providing a predictable billing cadence.
potential_benefits.source_text: The monthly service fee is due on the 5th day of each month.

potential_benefits.explanation: Upon full payment, the client owns the final website content created specifically for them.
potential_benefits.source_text: Upon full payment of all outstanding amounts, the Client will own the final website content specifically created for the Client.

potential_benefits.title: Fixed initial term
potential_benefits.explanation: The agreement starts on September 1, 2026 and runs for a defined twelve‑month period, giving the client a known commitment horizon.
potential_benefits.source_text: The initial term of this Agreement is twelve (12) months beginning on September 1, 2026 and ending on August 31, 2027.

potential_benefits.title: Confidentiality protection
potential_benefits.explanation: Both parties are contractually required to keep each other's confidential information private for three years after termination.
potential_benefits.source_text: Each party agrees to keep confidential information received from the other party confidential... The confidentiality obligations will continue for three (3) years after termination.

potential_benefits.title: Defined dispute process
potential_benefits.explanation: Disputes must first go through good‑faith negotiation before moving to arbitration, offering an initial opportunity to resolve issues informally.
potential_benefits.source_text: Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall first be addressed through good-faith negotiations... If the dispute cannot be resolved within thirty (30) days, the dispute shall be resolved through binding arbitration.

potential_concerns.title: Early termination charge
potential_concerns.explanation: If the client ends the agreement before the end of the initial twelve‑month term, they must pay a fee equal to 50% of the remaining monthly service fees.
potential_concerns.source_text: If the Client terminates the Agreement before the end of the initial term, the Client must pay an early termination fee equal to 50% of all remaining monthly service fees for the unused portion of the contract.

potential_concerns.title: Late payment penalty
potential_concerns.explanation: Payments overdue by more than five days incur a late fee of 5% of the outstanding amount.
potential_concerns.source_text: If any payment remains unpaid for more than five (5) days after the due date, the Client will be charged a late payment fee equal to 5% of the outstanding amount.

potential_concerns.title: Service suspension for non‑payment
potential_concerns.explanation: If payment remains unpaid for more than thirty days, the provider may suspend all services while the client remains liable for all fees.
potential_concerns.source_text: If payment remains unpaid for more than thirty (30) days, the Service Provider may suspend all services. The Client remains responsible for all fees during any period of service suspension.

potential_concerns.title: Automatic renewal with price changes
potential_concerns.explanation: The agreement renews automatically unless cancelled 60 days prior, and renewal fees are based on the provider’s current pricing, which may be changed with 30 days notice.
potential_concerns.source_text: Unless written cancellation notice is received at least sixty (60) days before the expiration date, the Agreement will automatically renew... Renewal fees will be based on the Service Provider's then-current pricing. The Service Provider may change its pricing for the renewal period by providing thirty (30) days written notice.

potential_concerns.title: Liability cap
potential_concerns.explanation: The provider’s total liability is limited to the amount of fees paid by the client in the previous three months and excludes indirect or consequential damages.
potential_concerns.source_text: The total liability of the Service Provider under this Agreement will not exceed the total amount of fees paid by the Client during the previous three (3) months.

potential_concerns.title: Binding arbitration requirement
potential_concerns.explanation: Unresolved disputes must be settled by binding arbitration in London, limiting court recourse.
potential_concerns.source_text: If the dispute cannot be resolved within thirty (30) days, the dispute shall be resolved through binding arbitration. The arbitration shall take place in London, United Kingdom.

potential_concerns.source_text: The Service Provider may modify service features, pricing, or policies by providing written notice to the Client. Continued use of the services after the effective date of the changes will constitute acceptance of the updated terms.

potential_concerns.title: Client material obligations

questions_to_consider: How will the renewal pricing be determined, and will the Service Provider provide a clear quote before the renewal period begins?
What specific actions will the Service Provider take if a payment is more than thirty days overdue, beyond the stated right to suspend services?
How is the early termination fee calculated if the Client ends the agreement before the initial twelve‑month term?
What are the exact confidentiality obligations after termination, and what types of information are covered?
What is the scope of the Service Provider's liability limitation, and does it cover any potential losses the Client might incur?
Can the Service Provider change service features or policies during the term, and how will the Client be notified of such changes?
What process will be followed for the binding arbitration in London, and what costs might the Client be responsible for?
